name: Shinkyoku Soukai Polyphonica - Memories White
original_name: 神曲奏界ポリフォニカ　Memories White
source:
Snow serves the dantists of the Granado family, however their "commandia", which gives the spirits strength, has been waning in each generation.
What does fate have in store for her?

[taken from [url=http://myanimelist.net/manga/20718/Shinkyoku_Soukai_Polyphonica_-_Eternal_White]MyAnimeList[/url]]
translation:
丝诺侍奉格拉纳多家族的神曲乐士，然而家族为精灵赋予力量的“Commandia”却一代比一代衰弱。
等待她的将会是怎样的命运？

[摘自[url=http://myanimelist.net/manga/20718/Shinkyoku_Soukai_Polyphonica_-_Eternal_White]MyAnimeList[/url]]
